item.title: Car is included! Theater is cool! Being sold fully furnished in Kansas. $1,500,000
item.description: The car is included! This house is being sold fully furnished. There are some really pretty details inside and I love the basement theater! The house was built in 1880. It is located on .9 acre in Abilene, Kansas. The house features a covered front porch, grand staircase, stunning wallpaper, beautiful chandeliers, alcove with bay windows, wainscoting, tall ceilings, transom windows, gorgeous crown moulding, in-laid hardwood floors and a Victorian theater that seats 23 people. item.title: What a pretty setting! Love the rolling lawn and fountain! One acre in Kentucky. $280,000
item.description: What a pretty setting with the rolling lawn! I love the fountain! The house was built in 1910. It is located on one acre in Benham, Kentucky. The house features a circular front drive, beautiful fountain, a covered front porch, wood floors, beautiful windows to take in the view and a sunroom with a fireplace. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,400 square feet. $280,000 Contact the property owner: 606-508-9953 From the Zillow listing: What we love about this home is our amazing neighbors The sky

item.title: Nice outdoor fireplace! Citrus trees on the property. On 20 acres in Louisiana. $425,000
item.description: Nice acreage with this house! I love the outdoor fireplace pavilion. There are citrus trees on the property. The house was built in 1930. It is located on 20 acres in Folsom, Louisiana. The house features a covered front porch, carport, baseboards and a large covered back porch. There is a pavilion with a pretty outdoor fireplace and there are a few outbuildings on the property. One bedroom, one bathroom and 783 square feet. $425,000 Contact Jeffery Puckett with Compass Slidell: 985-707-4145 Fro

item.title: Circa 1776! Apple trees and five acres of wild blueberries! 15 acres in Maine. $279,000
item.description: Circa 1776! Imagine all that this house has witnessed! Those fireplaces are huge! There are apple trees and five acres of wild blueberries on this property. The house was built in 1776. It is located on 15 acres in Cathance TWP, Maine. The house features wood floors, huge fireplaces, wainscoting, exposed beams, built-in bookshelves, chair rails and crown moulding. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,980 square feet. $279,000 Contact The Christopher Group From the Zillow listing: Have you dreamed

item.title: Circa 1790 in Massachusetts! I like some of the interior details! $199,970
item.description: This is an early house! I love some of the interior details! This house has a lot of potential. The home was built in 1790. It is located on .3 acre in Ashby, Massachusetts. The house features wide plank wood floors, vaulted ceiling, baseboards, exposed beams, original mantels and a large fireplace. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,455 square feet. $199,970 Contact The J. Pavao Team with Keller Williams South Watuppa: 774-319-1169 From the Zillow listing: Attention investors and contractors! item.title: Foyer floor is interesting! Circa 1930 in Michigan. $249,900
item.description: Not sure how I feel about the foyer floor. But there are some pretty details inside! The house was built in 1930. IT is located in Saginaw, Michigan. The house features a grand staircase, arched doors and windows, wood floors, crown moulding, baseobards, built-ins and updated bathrooms. There is a basement and a garage. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,430 square feet. $249,900 Contact Kelli Falco with RE/MAX of Owosso: 810-280-5391 From the Zillow listing: Looking for something truly unique?

item.title: New Jersey’s most expensive old house listing! Oceanfront! $20,000,000
item.description: Welcome to New Jersey’s most expensive old house listing! I believe this oceanfront property is owned by the co-founder of Urban Outfitters. The house was built in 1920. It is located on .69 acre in Bay Head, New Jersey. I’m not really liking all of the modern light fixtures. It is a French Normandy architecture. The original owners were inspired by coastal France homes. Eight bedrooms, seven bathrooms and 4,026 square feet. $20,000,000 From the Zillow listing: Inspired by the charm of coastal F

item.title: Stone cottage with rolled eaves! Over an acre in North Carolina. $225,000
item.description: I love stone houses! This one is unique with the rolled eaves! The house was built in 1939. It is located on 1.41 acres in Conover, North Carolina. The house features a unique exterior with stone and brick, rolled eaves, vintage kitchen cabinets, wood floors, pretty front door, arched entryways, stone fireplace, wide baseboards and french doors. There is a basement and a detached garage. Love how it says there are 402 bedrooms. I count two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,536 square feet. $225,000 C

item.title: Diamond in the Rough! Over one acre in Virginia. $185,000
item.description: This house looks like a diamond in the rough to me! But more diamond than rough! The house was built in 1910. It is located on 1.33 acres in Oak Hall, Virginia. The house features an enclosed side porch, wood floors, baseboards, built-in shelving, telephone nook, french doors, spacious kitchen with vintage cabinetry and two staircases. There is an attic for storage and the house has a lot of natural light. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,378 square feet. $185,000 Contact Hill Real Estate Gro

item.title: Cute House! Not far from the beach! Circa 1895 in Mississippi. $169,900
item.description: This is a cute house! So much potential to be even cuter! And it’s not far from local beaches! The house was built in 1895. It is located on .28 acre in Gulfport, Mississippi. The house features two covered porches, a carport, wood floors, stained glass transom window, claw foot tub and a decent kitchen. There is a large back porch. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,357 square feet. $169,900 Contact Rayna W. Brewer with Coldwell Banker: 228-234-2443 From the Zillow listing: Beautifully maintaine
